title: Squeeze and relax for a calm body
examples: How do I relax my body?

steps.label: Curl toes
steps.note: Curl your toes. Hold. Let go.

steps.label: Floppy body
steps.note: Go floppy like a rag doll.
steps.ask: When can I do squeeze and relax?

explain.say: When you feel worried or cross, your body gets tight, like a stretched rubber band. Here is a trick to let it go. Look at the board. We squeeze, then relax, one part at a time.

explain.say: See the hand? Squeeze your fists tight, like squeezing two lemons. One, two, three. Now let go. Feel how soft your hands are now? That soft feeling is relaxed.

explain.say: Now shoulders up! Lift them to your ears, like a turtle hiding. Hold, hold. Now drop them down. Next, scrunch your face tight, then let it go soft. Did you feel the difference?

explain.say: See the shoe? Curl your toes tight inside your shoes. Hold. Now let go. Squeezing first helps your muscles really feel what relaxed means. Which part feels the most relaxed?

explain.say: Last one, floppy body! Go floppy like a rag doll. Wonderful, your whole body is relaxed! Your challenge: try squeeze and relax tonight in bed, from your toes up to your face.

faq.a: Squeezing first makes the letting go feel bigger. Your muscles learn the difference between tight and soft.

faq.q: When can I do squeeze and relax?
faq.a: When you feel worried, cross, or tight. It is great at bedtime too. You can do the fists one quietly at your desk.
About three seconds. Squeeze firmly, but never so hard that it hurts.

faq.q: Can I do it sitting down?
faq.a: Yes. Fists, shoulders, face and toes all work in a chair.
asks: Can I do it at my desk?

faq.q: What if it does not help?
faq.a: Try belly breaths, a movement break, or telling a grown-up you trust. Different tools help at different times.

facts: Tensing and then relaxing muscles one group at a time is a well-known relaxation method.
When people feel worried, their muscles often tighten without them noticing.

quiz.say: In squeeze and relax, what do you do after squeezing?
quiz.why: After you squeeze, you let go and feel your muscles go soft.

wrong.1: Too much squeezing can hurt. Let go after three seconds.
wrong.2: Running is a different tool. Here, you relax.

quiz.say: Which body part do you curl inside your shoes?
quiz.show: What do you curl in your shoes?
quiz.why: You curl your toes, hold, then let go.

wrong.1: Ears do not curl in shoes!
wrong.2: Your nose is on your face, not in your shoes.
